purpose: Authorize one truth-free native implementation of the source-supported base-station pseudorange compensation after the Phase64 provenance policy recovery passed.

source_contract.base_member_selection: settings_train.csv Base1 selects the unique declared ${Base1}_rnx2.obs member for settings RINEX=V2
source_contract.base_model: For each matching base epoch/satellite/signal, evaluate the native broadcast-navigation pseudorange model at the finite RINEX-header APPROX POSITION XYZ; retain the source residual P_base - modeled_base with the receiver-clock term in the residual and no truth/WLS/precomputed coordinate.
source_contract.same_satellite_signal: match rover and base by the exact native satellite and signal identity; no cross-satellite, cross-constellation, cross-signal, or nearest-key fill
source_contract.time: use source observation timestamps and the native broadcast state/transmit-time contract; retain only finite base residual samples

moving_mean.selection: exact observed base interval dt=1.0 s -> 151; dt=15.0 s -> 11
moving_mean.edge_behavior: source smoothdata movmean centered windows with finite available samples at the boundaries; no endpoint hold or extrapolation

source_contract.interpolation: linearly interpolate the smoothed same-satellite/signal base residual at rover timestamps only inside the finite base time domain; no extrapolation, nearest fill, or endpoint hold
source_contract.sign: subtract the correction exactly: P_rover_corrected = P_rover - pc(t_rover), matching obsr.(f).resPc = obsr.(f).resPc - pc
source_contract.units: pseudorange, model, residual, and correction in metres; timestamps in native GNSS seconds

implementation_scope.target: FGO undifferenced pseudorange factors adopted by the existing native problem builder
allowed_inputs: raw Android device_imu.csv only for the unchanged FGO structural route
the exact Phase64-materialized base RINEX member
the finite base RINEX-header APPROX POSITION XYZ pinned below
implementation_scope.operation: build the base residual stream before native FGO pseudorange factor construction, then subtract the interpolated correction from adopted rover pseudorange only
implementation_scope.default: false; Phase43 no-base behavior and bytes remain unchanged when the flag is absent

telemetry_required.population: final adopted FGO undifferenced pseudorange factors only

structural_matrix.control: Phase43 base flags, no --native-base-pseudorange-compensation and no base RINEX argument; exact flag-off champion recipe
structural_matrix.candidate: same control flags plus --native-base-pseudorange-compensation and the route's pinned base RINEX
structural_matrix.candidate_repeat_identity: candidate run1/run2 key rows, coordinate fields, factor counts, correction telemetry, and canonical summaries are byte-identical except explicitly excluded timing fields
structural_matrix.control_identity: control output/summary/submission is byte-identical to the pinned Phase43 flag-off artifact after canonical path normalization
structural_matrix.flag_off_identity: omitting the candidate flag does not parse/open a base file and preserves Phase43 defaults/graph

fixed_structural_gates.correction_materiality_each_route: abs(pc) p50 >= 0.10 m and p95 >= 0.30 m
fixed_structural_gates.sign_synthetic: positive pc reduces corrected P by subtraction; opposite sign fails closed
fixed_structural_gates.any_failure: fail closed; stop before truth/accuracy and preserve Phase43 champion

forbidden_inputs: solver rerun after any truth read
decision_rule: This freeze authorizes source/tests implementation and a truth-free structural matrix only. It does not authorize accuracy truth. Any source drift, archive/materialized hash mismatch, nonfinite model/correction, out-of-domain interpolation, candidate/control identity failure, repeat mismatch, missing telemetry, default mutation, or structural gate failure is a no-go with no truth read.

phase_policy.phase43_champion: preserve exact no-base default and flag-off artifact
phase_policy.accuracy: requires a new immutable scorer freeze after structural pass; 0.782 is not evaluated in Phase65
